title: Build EditorialGrid layout component
acceptance_criteria:
- CSS grid has template columns 260px 1fr 320px
  verify_by: test
- Define panel spans grid-row 1/3 in column 1
  verify_by: test
- Learn panel spans grid-row 1/3 in column 3
  verify_by: test
- Judge occupies row 1 column 2, Execute occupies row 2 column 2
  verify_by: test
- Gap is 16px, padding is 24px
  verify_by: manual
- Minimum width 1280px on container
  verify_by: manual

spec_references.requirement: T-shape layout: Define left (260px), Judge top center, Execute bottom center, Learn right (320px)
T-shape layout: center splits horizontally, sidebars span full height

rationale: EditorialGrid is pure layout with no data logic. Separated from the page component so layout can be snapshot-tested independently. Parallel with panel components since it uses ReactNode slots rather than importing panels directly.
decisions: Used inline styles (not CSS modules or Tailwind utilities) for all grid-specific values — 260px/1fr/320px column tracks and fractional row spans have no Tailwind equivalents, and the project convention for design-token values is inline styles.
Added data-testid attributes to the four cell wrapper divs to enable direct style assertions in tests without relying on fragile DOM traversal.
Kept the component to a single exported function with no sub-components — it is pure layout with no conditional rendering logic.
concerns: The test file is flagged as 'undeclared' by the scope gate (only EditorialGrid.tsx was declared). This is a gate-metadata gap, not a code problem — the test belongs alongside the component.

The git diff warning ('ambiguous argument main...branch') appears in both fast and full runs. This indicates the branch has no common ancestor visible in this worktree's git history; the gate treats it as a non-fatal warning and still passes.
